description: A cramped dispatch floor: a horseshoe of consoles, a wall of pigeonholes stuffed with airway bills, and a coffee machine that has achieved a kind of tar-based sentience. A dispatcher's headset crackles with runs to yards that may not exist anymore.

window.description: A full-height pane onto the street, kept just clean enough to trade through. Whatever the weather is doing out there, it is doing it in plain view.
window.name: the shopfront window
